title: Sar'theris Strand
wikitext:
[[Image:Sartheris_Strand.jpg|thumb|Sar'theris Strand]]
'''Sar'theris Strand''' is the name of the coast of [[Desolace]]. It is heavily populated by [[sea giant]]s, [[naga]], and [[makrura]]. The Karnitol Shipwreck lies off the northern part of the strand, and a small boat lies smashed on the beach below [[Ethel Rethor]]. Though Desolace is a grey, gloomy wasteland, the Sar'theris Strand is sunny and grassy.  It is off this coast that [[Sar'theris Striker]] can be fished for Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme.
